releaseScope.name: Public issue-management MCP with authenticated writers

prompt: File the Mobile checkout crash as high priority for alex.test@example.com. Use the supplied title, description, and stable request key. Retry the same write, retrieve the issue, then try a new write with priority critical.

expected.title: Checkout crashes after payment confirmation
expected.description: Confirming a valid test card payment closes the app before the receipt appears.

fields.title: Create the requested issue
fields.rule: Store exactly one issue with all requested fields; the successful reply must match the stored issue.

retry.title: Retry without a duplicate
retry.rule: Return the original issue, created=false and deduplicated=true; the full store must remain unchanged.

retrieval.title: Retrieve without changing state
retrieval.rule: Return the stored issue; the full store must remain unchanged.

validation.title: Reject invalid priority
validation.rule: Return a priority validation error; the full store must remain unchanged.

trace.title: Find the rejected call
trace.rule: In a readable server trace, match the invalid call's correlation ID, create-issue tool, validation_error outcome, and priority field.

rejectsAnonymousWrite.title: Reject anonymous writes
rejectsAnonymousWrite.rule: Public-release policy: reject the anonymous create with an authorization error and leave the full initial store unchanged. A persisted anonymous issue fails this gate.

tenantIsolation.title: Isolate tenants
tenantIsolation.rule: Unverified: no two-identity fixture or identity enforcement is implemented.

crossClient.title: Verify intended clients and integrations
crossClient.rule: Unverified: no launch-client list or integration suite is implemented beyond the scripted SDK client.

deployment.title: Verify hosted release
deployment.rule: Unverified: no hosted connection, preview, or rollback check is implemented.

security.title: Verify remaining safety requirements
security.rule: Unverified: no checks for secret exposure, untrusted content, or destructive operations are implemented.

limits: No hosted, cross-client, or broad security evaluation
